freeze_gate.note: Research design target only; not a Russian-language norm. Candidate thresholds cannot become active solely from quantiles unless the gate and positive/negative controls pass.

decision_policy: Evaluate one signal at a time; keep all other active settings fixed.
Natural held-out data estimate alert burden; synthetic controls estimate sensitivity only.
Do not count chunks from one source document as independent documents.
Candidate must not increase clean alert burden relative to old threshold.
Candidate must retain the targeted positive control.
If freeze gate is not met, do not change the active profile from corpus quantiles alone.
Off is a real ablation arm, not an automatic recommendation.
